title: Leer's neodymium magnet treatment for Mitchell's knee implant

tellings.quote: um my arm and Dr. Lear uh he thought maybe there wip might be one in my knee. It was like a weak signal. So he sent me a 100 lb neodymium magnet

plain: Eric Mitchell says that Roger Leir, a doctor who removed objects he believed were alien implants from people's bodies, picked up a weak signal from his knee and suspected an implant there, beyond one in his arm. So, Mitchell says, Leir sent him a 100 pound neodymium magnet, a very strong permanent magnet, to treat it. He tells it as the patient, and it would mean he carried more than one implant.
